title: Giddy Hop!
subtitle: On your horses, get set, go!

startup.noCameraApi: This browser does not allow camera access here (localhost or https required).
startup.cameraProblem: Camera/detection not available ({{message}}). Press T to play with the keyboard anyway.

register.position: Stand side by side in front of the camera (about 2–3 m away).
register.whenReady: As soon as everyone is ready, off we go!
register.keys: Space = everyone ready · Backspace = unregister all · T = keyboard rider · F = fullscreen
register.safety: ⚠️ Leave enough space, clear away obstacles, keep the laptop out of reach – an adult keeps an eye on it.

countdown.controls: Bounce = gallop · Lean = steer · Jump up = hop!
countdown.keys: During the race: Space = pause · B = end · Q = abort

pause.title: ⏸ Paused
pause.keys: B = end the race and go to the award ceremony · Q = abort, back to the start

update.offlineReady: The game can now be played offline, too.

results.title: 🏆 Award ceremony
results.ribbon: Every horse gets a ribbon – well ridden! 🎀
results.backSoon: Back to the registration in a moment · B or Q = right now

hud.lost: 👀 I can't see you – please stand in your spot again!

sounds.title: 🔊 Own sounds
sounds.intro: Own recordings instead of the built-in sounds. The files stay on this device – nothing is uploaded.
sounds.rules: Formats: mp3, ogg or wav, at most {{mb}} MB per file. Several files per sound are played in turn. A sound package is a .zip file; the start of each file name decides the sound: whinny… = whinny, snort… = snort, hoof… = hoofbeat.
sounds.ignored_one: {{count}} file in the package matches no sound and was skipped.
sounds.ignored_other: {{count}} files in the package match no sound and were skipped.

problem.format: {{name}}: format not supported (only mp3, ogg, wav).
problem.decode: {{name}}: cannot be played – is it really an audio file?
problem.tooMany: {{name}}: too many files for one sound (at most {{max}}).

sounds.notZip: This is not a valid .zip file.
sounds.packageSize: The sound package is too large (at most {{mb}} MB).
